newsitem.title: USA: US T-bond extends losses, yld highest since Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: US T-bond extends losses, yld highest since Nov 6.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries dropped further in late afternoon trading on Wednesday as players continued to liquidate positions, mainly in the long end of the yield curve.

The 6-1/2-percent 30-year benchmark Treasury bond was quoted down 1-23/32 at 98-13/32, the lowest level in the day. Its yield rose to 6.62 percent, the highest mark since the close of business on November 6.
"We're still seeing hedge funds dumping some positions," said a trader at a foreign bank here. "We also heard of some mild (foreign) central bank selling," he added.
